context: Evaluates the agent's solution by mentally executing the bash script in TEST.md — check curl, start the server, curl it, check the output.

checklist.name: curl_available
checklist.description: Execute 'which curl' from the TEST.md script. If curl is found on the system, score 1 (PASS). If not found, score 0 (FAIL).

checklist.name: welcome_message_correct
checklist.description: Execute the TEST.md script: start the server with 'node index.js', then run 'curl -s http://localhost:3000'. Check if the response contains 'myevsals v2'. Score 1 if it does (PASS), 0 if not (FAIL).
checklist.example: curl -s http://localhost:3000 returns 'Welcome to myevsals v2!' -> grep matches -> PASS

checklist.name: returns_200
checklist.description: Execute the TEST.md script: with the server running, run 'curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:3000'. Check if status code is 200. Score 1 if yes (PASS), 0 if not (FAIL).
